name: Work Session Tracker Pro
description:
Work Session Tracker Pro for Corsair XENEON Edge.

Keep your current work visible, then turn repeated focus sessions into useful personal history. Pro uses the same simple start, pause, resume and finish workflow as Lite, with no Pomodoro schedule, account, cloud sync or team timesheet.

Save recurring projects and give them colors so one tap can start familiar work. Set a daily focus goal, see goal progress while you work, review the last seven local days, compare project totals, and keep a 120 day session history on the device's local widget storage.

Break sessions can be tracked without inflating focus totals. If the latest focus session needs a small correction, adjust it by plus or minus five minutes with safeguards that prevent negative duration.

Time is derived from persisted timestamp segments instead of an in-memory counter. Active and paused sessions recover after widget reloads and iCUE restarts. Sessions crossing midnight are allocated to the correct local day, and daylight saving day boundaries use local calendar midnights.

Compact layouts keep the current task and today's essentials readable. Larger layouts open the richer Today, 7 Days and Projects views while preserving touch friendly controls.

No account, helper app, cloud sync or external service is required.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for Corsair XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial Pro release. Everything in the core work session tracker plus saved projects, project colors, daily focus goal and progress, 7 day totals, project totals, 120 day local session history, break tracking, safe ±5 minute correction for the latest focus session, richer history views, and eight tuned XENEON Edge layouts.
